title.en: How to Be a Good Friend

subtitle.en: Kind words, sharing, saying sorry and personal space
subtitle.hg: Pyaar se bolna, sharing, sorry bolna aur personal space

hook.en: A good friend makes you feel happy and safe. You can be that friend too!
hook.hg: Achha dost woh hai jiske saath tum khush aur safe feel karo. Tum bhi aise dost ban sakte ho!

objectives.en: Say what a kind friend does.
objectives.hg: Bata sako ki ek achha dost kya-kya karta hai.

objectives.en: Know how to say sorry when you hurt someone.
objectives.hg: Jaan sako ki kisi ko hurt ho jaye toh sorry kaise bolte hain.

objectives.en: Know that everyone has personal space.
objectives.hg: Samajh sako ki har kisi ka apna personal space hota hai.

body.en: A friend is someone you like to play and talk with. A good friend uses kind words. A good friend listens to you. A good friend does not hit, push or call you bad names. You can have one friend or many friends. Both are okay.
body.hg: Dost woh hota hai jiske saath khelna aur baatein karna tumhe achha lagta hai. Achha dost pyaar se bolta hai. Achha dost tumhari baat sunta hai. Achha dost maarta nahi, dhakka nahi deta aur gande naam se nahi bulata. Tumhara ek dost ho ya bahut saare, dono theek hain.

body.en: Sharing means letting a friend use your things for some time. Taking turns means first you, then me. Waiting can feel hard. Everyone feels that. You can ask, 'Can I have a turn after you?' Some things are very special to you. Then you can say kindly, 'This one I want to keep with me.'
body.hg: Sharing ka matlab hai apni cheez thodi der ke liye dost ko dena. Turn lene ka matlab hai pehle tum, phir main. Wait karna mushkil lag sakta hai. Aisa sabko lagta hai. Tum pooch sakte ho, 'Tumhare baad meri turn?' Kuch cheezein tumhe bahut pyaari hoti hain. Tab pyaar se keh do, 'Yeh wali mujhe apne paas rakhni hai.'

body.en: Everyone makes mistakes. Sometimes we hurt a friend. When that happens, say what you did: 'I am sorry I pushed you.' Then ask, 'Are you okay?' Try not to do it again. If a friend says sorry to you, you can say, 'Thank you for saying sorry.' Then you can play together again.
body.hg: Galti sabse hoti hai. Kabhi-kabhi humse dost ko chot ya dukh pahunch jata hai. Tab batao ki tumne kya kiya: 'Sorry, maine tumhe dhakka diya.' Phir poocho, 'Tum theek ho?' Koshish karo ki dobara aisa na ho. Agar dost tumse sorry bole, toh keh sakte ho, 'Sorry bolne ke liye thank you.' Phir dobara saath mein khelo.

body.en: Imagine a bubble around your body. That is your personal space. Some friends like hugs. Some do not. So ask first: 'Can I hug you?' If your friend says no, stop. If someone comes too close to you, you can say, 'Please give me space.' If they do not stop, tell a grown-up you trust.
body.hg: Socho ki tumhari body ke charon taraf ek bubble hai. Yahi tumhara personal space hai. Kuch doston ko hug pasand hai, kuch ko nahi. Isliye pehle poocho: 'Kya main tumhe hug kar loon?' Dost mana kare toh ruk jao. Agar koi tumhare bahut paas aaye, toh bol sakte ho, 'Please thodi jagah do.' Woh na ruke toh kisi bharosemand bade ko batao.

claim.en: If my friend plays with someone else, they are not my friend any more.
claim.hg: Agar mera dost kisi aur ke saath khele, toh woh ab mera dost nahi raha.

fact.en: Friends can have many friends. Your friend can play with others and still like you just as much. You can play with others too.
fact.hg: Doston ke aur bhi dost ho sakte hain. Tumhara dost doosron ke saath khel kar bhi tumhe utna hi pasand karta hai. Tum bhi doosron ke saath khel sakte ho.

takeaways.en: Good friends use kind words and gentle hands.
takeaways.hg: Achhe dost pyaar se bolte hain aur kisi ko chot nahi pahunchate.

takeaways.en: Saying sorry helps fix a hurt.
takeaways.hg: Sorry bolne se hurt theek hone mein help milti hai.

takeaways.en: Ask before you hug, and stop if your friend says no.
takeaways.hg: Hug karne se pehle poocho, aur dost mana kare toh ruk jao.

activity.en: Draw a picture of you and a friend doing something kind together. Show it to a grown-up at home and tell them what is happening in it.
activity.hg: Ek drawing banao jisme tum aur tumhara dost milkar koi achha kaam kar rahe ho. Ghar mein kisi bade ko dikhao aur batao ki drawing mein kya ho raha hai.

q.en: You bumped into your friend by mistake and she fell down. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Galti se tum apni dost se takra gaye aur woh gir gayi. Sabse achha kya karna hoga?

options.en: Say it was her fault
options.hg: Bol do ki galti usi ki thi

options.en: Say sorry and ask if she is okay
options.hg: Sorry bolo aur poocho ki woh theek hai ya nahi

options.en: Walk away and say nothing
options.hg: Bina kuch bole wahan se chale jao

explain.en: Saying sorry and checking on your friend shows you care, even when it was a mistake.
explain.hg: Sorry bolna aur dost ka haal poochna dikhata hai ki tumhe uski care hai, chahe galti se hi hua ho.

q.en: You should ask before you hug a friend.
q.hg: Dost ko hug karne se pehle poochna chahiye.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Everyone has personal space. Asking first shows respect, and some friends do not like hugs.
explain.hg: Har kisi ka personal space hota hai. Pehle poochna respect dikhata hai, aur kuch doston ko hug pasand nahi hota.

subtitle.en: Healthy friendships, new feelings and peer pressure
subtitle.hg: Healthy dosti, nayi feelings aur peer pressure

hook.en: Friend groups shift, someone gives you butterflies, and suddenly everyone has an opinion. Here is how to handle it without losing yourself.
hook.hg: Friend groups badalte hain, kisi ko dekh kar butterflies aati hain, aur achanak sabke paas opinion hota hai. Jaano ki khud ko khoye bina yeh sab kaise handle karein.

objectives.en: Tell the difference between a friendship that feels good and one that keeps hurting.
objectives.hg: Farq pehchaan sako ki kaunsi dosti achha feel karati hai aur kaunsi baar-baar hurt karti hai.

objectives.en: Understand that a crush is a normal feeling, not a problem to fix.
objectives.hg: Samajh sako ki crush ek normal feeling hai, koi problem nahi jise fix karna pade.

objectives.en: Use at least one clear way to say no to peer pressure.
objectives.hg: Peer pressure ko no bolne ka kam se kam ek clear tareeka use kar sako.

h.en: What a healthy friendship feels like
h.hg: Healthy dosti kaisi feel hoti hai

body.en: A healthy friendship is mostly easy. You can be yourself, you both get a turn to talk and decide, and you feel better after spending time together, not smaller. Good friends keep your private things private, say sorry when they mess up and are happy when you do well. Every friendship has bad days, so look at the usual pattern. If a friend often mocks you, leaves you out on purpose, spreads your secrets or stays friendly only when you obey, that friendship is hurting you. You are allowed to step back and spend time with others.
body.hg: Healthy dosti zyadatar easy lagti hai. Tum jaise ho waise reh sakte ho, bolne aur decide karne ki turn dono ko milti hai, aur saath time bita kar tum achha feel karte ho, chhota nahi. Achhe dost tumhari private baatein apne tak rakhte hain, galti hone par sorry bolte hain aur tumhari success par khush hote hain. Har dosti mein bure din aate hain, isliye roz ka pattern dekho. Agar koi dost aksar mazaak udaye, jaan-boojh kar left out kare, tumhare secrets failaye ya tabhi achha rahe jab tum uski maano, toh woh dosti tumhe hurt kar rahi hai. Tum peeche hat sakte ho aur doosron ke saath time bita sakte ho.

h.hg: Crush ek feeling hai, order nahi

body.en: A crush is a strong liking for someone: you think about them a lot, feel shy or excited near them, or want them to notice you. Crushes usually begin around puberty and are normal. Not having one is just as normal. A crush can be on anyone, and it often fades in weeks or months. You do not have to tell the person, date them or do anything at all. If you find out about someone's crush, do not tease them or announce it. And if someone does not like you back, that is their right; leave them in peace.
body.hg: Crush ka matlab hai kisi ko bahut zyada pasand karna: uske baare mein baar-baar sochna, uske paas shy ya excited feel karna, ya chahna ki woh tumhe notice kare. Crush aksar puberty ke aas-paas shuru hote hain aur yeh normal hai. Crush na hona bhi utna hi normal hai. Crush kisi par bhi ho sakta hai aur aksar kuch hafton ya mahinon mein halka pad jata hai. Tumhe us insaan ko batana, date karna ya kuch bhi karna zaroori nahi hai. Agar tumhe kisi ke crush ka pata chal jaye, toh use chidhao mat aur sabko announce mat karo. Aur agar koi tumhe wapas pasand na kare, toh yeh uska haq hai; use pareshan mat karo.

h.en: Peer pressure: when the group pushes
h.hg: Peer pressure: jab group push kare

body.en: Peer pressure is when people your age push you to do something so that you fit in: a dare, skipping class, mocking a classmate, trying a cigarette, sending a photo. It works because nobody likes to be left out. Try a short, firm line: 'No, I'm not doing that.' You do not owe a long explanation. You can suggest something else, walk towards another group or blame a rule at home if that feels easier. Pressure can also be good, like friends pushing you to practise or study. Ask yourself: would I still want to do this if nobody was watching?
body.hg: Peer pressure matlab jab tumhari age ke log tum par kuch karne ka pressure daalein taaki tum group mein fit ho sako: koi dare, class bunk karna, kisi classmate ka mazaak udana, cigarette try karna, photo bhejna. Yeh isliye kaam karta hai kyunki left out hona kisi ko achha nahi lagta. Ek chhoti, firm line bolo: 'Nahi, mujhe yeh nahi karna.' Lambi explanation dena zaroori nahi. Tum kuch aur karne ka idea de sakte ho, doosre group ki taraf ja sakte ho, ya easy lage toh ghar ke rule ka bahana bana sakte ho. Pressure achha bhi ho sakta hai, jaise dost practice ya padhai ke liye push karein. Khud se poocho: agar koi dekh nahi raha hota, toh kya tab bhi mera mann yeh karne ka hota?

h.hg: Doston ke beech privacy, online bhi

body.en: Trust grows when private things stay private. Do not forward a friend's messages, photos or secrets, even as a joke, and ask before you post a picture that has someone else in it. Do not share passwords, even with a best friend; friendships change and accounts get misused. One kind of secret must never be kept: if a friend tells you someone is hurting them, touching them in an unsafe way or scaring them online, tell a trusted adult. That is not betrayal. It is how friends keep each other safe. You can also call Child Helpline 1098.
body.hg: Trust tab badhta hai jab private baatein private rehti hain. Dost ke messages, photos ya secrets forward mat karo, mazaak mein bhi nahi, aur jis photo mein koi aur ho use post karne se pehle pooch lo. Password kisi se share mat karo, best friend se bhi nahi; dostiyan badalti hain aur account ka misuse ho sakta hai. Ek tarah ka secret kabhi nahi rakhna chahiye: agar dost bataye ki koi use hurt kar raha hai, galat tareeke se chhoo raha hai ya online dara raha hai, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao. Yeh dhokha nahi hai. Dost aise hi ek-doosre ko safe rakhte hain. Tum Child Helpline 1098 par bhi call kar sakte ho.

claim.en: If you say no to your friends, you will end up with no friends.
claim.hg: Agar doston ko no bologe, toh koi dost nahi bachega.

fact.en: Real friends may be annoyed for a while, but they stay. A group that drops you for refusing a dare was offering membership, not friendship. A calm, clear no usually earns more respect than people admit.
fact.hg: Asli dost thodi der irritate ho sakte hain, par saath nahi chhodte. Jo group ek dare se mana karne par tumhe drop kar de, woh dosti nahi, bas membership de raha tha. Calm aur clear 'no' ki respect log jitna maante hain usse zyada karte hain.

takeaways.en: A good friendship lets you be yourself and leaves you feeling better most of the time.
takeaways.hg: Achhi dosti mein tum jaise ho waise reh sakte ho aur zyadatar time achha feel karte ho.

takeaways.en: A crush is a normal feeling that you do not have to act on, and not having one is normal too.
takeaways.hg: Crush ek normal feeling hai jis par kuch karna zaroori nahi, aur crush na hona bhi normal hai.

takeaways.en: A short, calm no is enough; you do not owe the group an explanation.
takeaways.hg: Chhota, calm 'no' kaafi hai; group ko explanation dena tumhari zimmedari nahi.

activity.en: Write down three things you value in a friend. Then honestly tick the ones you do for your own friends, and pick one to do better this week.
activity.hg: Teen cheezein likho jo tumhe ek dost mein achhi lagti hain. Phir honestly unpar tick karo jo tum khud apne doston ke liye karte ho, aur ek choose karo jise is hafte better karoge.

q.en: Your group dares you to hide a classmate's school bag as a joke. You do not want to. What is the strongest response?
q.hg: Tumhara group mazaak mein ek classmate ka bag chhupane ka dare deta hai. Tumhara mann nahi hai. Sabse strong response kya hoga?

options.en: Do it once so they stop asking
options.hg: Ek baar kar do taaki woh peeche padna chhod dein

options.en: Laugh along and let someone else do it
options.hg: Saath mein hans lo aur kisi aur ko karne do

options.en: Say 'No, I'm not doing that' and suggest something else
options.hg: Bolo 'Nahi, mujhe yeh nahi karna' aur kuch aur karne ka idea do

options.en: Stop talking to the whole group for good
options.hg: Poore group se hamesha ke liye baat band kar do

explain.en: A short, firm no plus another idea protects the classmate and keeps you in control, without needing to cut everyone off.
explain.hg: Chhota, firm 'no' aur saath mein doosra idea classmate ko bhi bachata hai aur control tumhare haath mein rakhta hai, sabse rishta tode bina.

q.en: If you have a crush on someone, you have to tell them.
q.hg: Agar kisi par crush hai, toh use batana zaroori hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: A crush is a feeling you can simply notice. Telling, dating or doing anything about it is optional, and many crushes fade on their own.
explain.hg: Crush ek feeling hai jise tum bas notice kar sakte ho. Batana, date karna ya kuch bhi karna optional hai, aur kaafi crush apne aap fade ho jate hain.

subtitle.en: What a healthy relationship is actually made of
subtitle.hg: Healthy relationship asal mein kin cheezon se banta hai

hook.en: Films sell you drama as love. Real healthy relationships are calmer, kinder and far less controlling than that.
hook.hg: Filmein drama ko pyaar bol kar bechti hain. Asli healthy relationships usse kahin zyada calm, kind aur bina control wale hote hain.

objectives.en: Describe attraction as a normal part of growing up that does not have to be acted on.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki attraction bade hone ka normal hissa hai aur us par kuch karna zaroori nahi.

objectives.en: Name the core ingredients of a healthy relationship: respect, trust, honest communication and equality.
objectives.hg: Healthy relationship ke core ingredients gina sako: respect, trust, honest communication aur equality.

objectives.en: Set and respect boundaries, including digital ones.
objectives.hg: Boundaries set kar sako aur doosron ki boundaries respect kar sako, digital wali bhi.

h.en: Attraction is normal, and so is waiting
h.hg: Attraction normal hai, aur wait karna bhi

body.en: In your teens, hormones and brain development make romantic and sexual attraction stronger. You may be drawn to people of a different gender, the same gender, more than one gender, or feel little attraction right now. All of that is within normal human variety. Feeling attracted does not mean you must date, and many teenagers do not. If you do like someone, the feeling is yours to manage; the other person owes you nothing. Under Indian law (POCSO), any sexual activity with a person under 18 is an offence, even if both agreed and even if both are teenagers. So waiting is not old-fashioned; it protects you both.
body.hg: Teenage mein hormones aur brain development ki wajah se romantic aur sexual attraction zyada feel hone lagta hai. Tumhe alag gender ke, apne hi gender ke ya ek se zyada gender ke log achhe lag sakte hain, ya abhi khaas attraction feel na ho. Yeh sab human variety ka normal hissa hai. Attraction feel hone ka matlab yeh nahi ki date karna zaroori hai; bahut se teenagers nahi karte. Agar koi pasand hai, toh us feeling ko handle karna tumhara kaam hai; saamne wale par tumhara kuch udhaar nahi. Indian law (POCSO) ke under 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual activity offence hai, chahe dono raazi hon aur chahe dono teenagers hon. Isliye wait karna old-fashioned nahi; yeh tum dono ko protect karta hai.

body.en: Healthy relationships, romantic or not, run on four things. Respect: your opinions, body, time, studies and friendships are treated as important. Trust: you do not need to check on each other because you both keep your word. Honest communication: you can say what you feel and hear a different view without fear. Equality: decisions are shared and nobody is the boss. Notice how you feel on most days. Relaxed, free to be yourself and able to say no is a good sign. Anxious, watched or often guilty is a sign that something needs to change.
body.hg: Healthy relationships, romantic hon ya nahi, chaar cheezon par chalte hain. Respect: tumhari opinion, body, time, padhai aur dostiyon ko importance di jati hai. Trust: ek-doosre ko check karne ki zaroorat nahi padti kyunki dono apni baat nibhate hain. Honest communication: tum bina darr ke apni baat keh sakte ho aur alag opinion sun sakte ho. Equality: decisions milkar hote hain aur koi kisi ka boss nahi hota. Notice karo ki zyadatar din tum kaisa feel karte ho. Relaxed, khud jaise rehne ki freedom aur no bol paana green flag hai. Anxious, har waqt watched ya baar-baar guilty feel karna batata hai ki kuch badalne ki zaroorat hai.

body.en: A boundary is a limit you set about what is okay for you: how much you text, what you share, how you are touched, how you are spoken to. Say it plainly: 'I'm not comfortable with that', 'I need time with my friends too'. You do not have to justify it or apologise for it. A person who cares may feel disappointed but will accept it. Sulking, repeating the request, guilt-tripping or going silent until you give in is pressure, not love. Boundaries work both ways: when someone tells you theirs, you respect it the first time.
body.hg: Boundary woh limit hai jo tum set karte ho ki tumhare liye kya okay hai: kitna text karna hai, kya share karna hai, tumhe kaise touch kiya jaye, tumse kaise baat ki jaye. Ise seedha bolo: 'Main isme comfortable nahi hoon', 'Mujhe apne doston ke saath bhi time chahiye'. Iski safai dena ya sorry bolna zaroori nahi. Jise tumhari care hai woh disappoint ho sakta hai, par maan lega. Muh phulana, baar-baar wahi maangna, guilt-trip karna ya tab tak chup ho jana jab tak tum maan na jao, yeh pressure hai, pyaar nahi. Boundary dono taraf chalti hai: jab koi apni limit bataye, toh pehli baar mein hi respect karo.

body.en: Being close does not mean being on call all day. Healthy digital boundaries include keeping your own passwords, not being made to share live location, replying when you can instead of instantly, and never being pushed to send photos. Reading someone's chats secretly or demanding screenshots is surveillance. Feeling jealous now and then is human; the healthy move is to say 'I felt insecure when…' and talk. When jealousy turns into rules about who you can talk to or what you can wear, it has become possessiveness. That is a warning pattern worth discussing with someone you trust.
body.hg: Close hone ka matlab 24 ghante available rehna nahi hai. Healthy digital boundaries mein aata hai: apne passwords apne paas rakhna, live location share karne ke liye majboor na kiya jana, turant ke bajaye jab time mile tab reply kar paana, aur photos bhejne ka pressure kabhi na hona. Chupke se kisi ki chats padhna ya screenshots maangna surveillance hai. Kabhi-kabhi jealous feel karna insaani baat hai; healthy move hai bolna 'Mujhe insecure laga jab…' aur baat karna. Jab jealousy is baat ke rules ban jaye ki tum kisse baat karoge ya kya pehnoge, toh woh possessiveness ban chuki hai. Yeh warning pattern hai jis par kisi trusted insaan se baat karni chahiye.

claim.en: If someone really loves you, they will share all their passwords with you.
claim.hg: Jo sach mein pyaar karta hai, woh apne saare passwords tumhe de dega.

fact.en: Privacy and trust go together. Wanting your own password, chats and space is not hiding something; demanding access as 'proof of love' is a form of control.
fact.hg: Privacy aur trust saath-saath chalte hain. Apna password, chats aur space chahna kuch chhupana nahi hai; 'pyaar ka proof' bol kar access maangna control ka ek form hai.

takeaways.en: Attraction is a normal feeling that you can notice without acting on it.
takeaways.hg: Attraction ek normal feeling hai jise notice karna kaafi hai, us par kuch karna zaroori nahi.

takeaways.en: Respect, trust, honest communication and equality are the base of every healthy relationship.
takeaways.hg: Respect, trust, honest communication aur equality har healthy relationship ki neenv hain.

takeaways.en: A boundary needs no justification, and pressure after a no is not love.
takeaways.hg: Boundary ke liye justification ki zaroorat nahi, aur 'no' ke baad pressure daalna pyaar nahi hai.

activity.en: Privately list two boundaries that matter to you, for example about your phone, your time or how people speak to you. Write one sentence you could use to state each one calmly.
activity.hg: Privately do boundaries likho jo tumhare liye matter karti hain, jaise apne phone, apne time ya log tumse kaise baat karte hain uske baare mein. Har ek ke liye ek sentence likho jo tum calmly bol sako.

q.en: Which of these is a sign of a healthy relationship?
q.hg: Inme se kaunsa healthy relationship ka sign hai?

options.en: You can disagree without being afraid of the reaction
options.hg: Tum reaction se dare bina disagree kar sakte ho

options.en: You always know each other's live location
options.hg: Tum dono ko hamesha ek-doosre ki live location pata rehti hai

options.en: You have stopped meeting friends so that nobody gets jealous
options.hg: Tumne doston se milna chhod diya hai taaki kisi ko jealousy na ho

options.en: Neither of you ever says no to the other
options.hg: Tum dono ek-doosre ko kabhi no nahi bolte

explain.en: Feeling safe to disagree shows respect and equality. Tracking, isolation and never saying no point towards control, not closeness.
explain.hg: Bina darr ke disagree kar paana respect aur equality dikhata hai. Tracking, isolation aur kabhi no na bolna closeness nahi, control ki taraf ishara karte hain.

q.en: Dev tells Sana, 'I don't want to share my Instagram password.' Sana keeps asking for three days and then stops talking to him. What is Sana doing?
q.hg: Dev Sana se bolta hai, 'Main apna Instagram password share nahi karna chahta.' Sana teen din tak maangti rehti hai aur phir usse baat karna band kar deti hai. Sana kya kar rahi hai?

options.en: Showing how much she cares
options.hg: Dikha rahi hai ki use kitni care hai

options.en: Setting a boundary of her own
options.hg: Apni khud ki boundary set kar rahi hai

options.en: Pressuring him to give up his boundary
options.hg: Us par apni boundary chhodne ka pressure daal rahi hai

options.en: Resolving the disagreement fairly
options.hg: Disagreement ko fair tareeke se solve kar rahi hai

explain.en: Repeating a request after a clear no and using silence as punishment are pressure tactics. A boundary is about your own limits, not about access to someone else's account.
explain.hg: Clear 'no' ke baad baar-baar maangna aur punishment ki tarah silent ho jana pressure tactics hain. Boundary apni limits ke baare mein hoti hai, kisi aur ke account ke access ke baare mein nahi.

subtitle.en: Love bombing, gaslighting, control and abuse
subtitle.hg: Love bombing, gaslighting, control aur abuse

hook.en: Unhealthy relationships rarely begin badly. Many begin feeling like the best thing that ever happened to you. Learn the patterns, not just the labels.
hook.hg: Unhealthy relationships shuru mein bure nahi lagte. Kaafi toh aise start hote hain jaise life ki best cheez mil gayi ho. Sirf labels nahi, patterns pehchanna seekho.

objectives.en: Recognise love bombing, gaslighting, possessiveness and control as patterns that build over time.
objectives.hg: Love bombing, gaslighting, possessiveness aur control ko time ke saath banne wale patterns ki tarah pehchaan sako.

objectives.en: Distinguish emotional abuse, physical abuse and sexual coercion, and understand that none of them is the fault of the person targeted.
objectives.hg: Emotional abuse, physical abuse aur sexual coercion mein farq kar sako, aur samajh sako ki inme se kisi mein bhi jhelne wale ki galti nahi hoti.

objectives.en: Know safe first steps for yourself or a friend.
objectives.hg: Apne liye ya kisi dost ke liye safe first steps jaan sako.

h.en: Patterns matter more than single moments
h.hg: Ek moment nahi, pattern matter karta hai

body.en: Anyone can be jealous, snappy or selfish on a bad day. One such moment does not make a person abusive, and this lesson cannot diagnose anybody. What matters is the pattern: does the behaviour repeat, does it get worse, does the person take responsibility when told, and is the effect that you feel smaller, more afraid or more cut off than before? A useful check is direction. In a healthy relationship your world slowly gets bigger. In a controlling one it shrinks: fewer friends, fewer choices, less confidence.
body.hg: Bure din mein koi bhi jealous, chidchida ya selfish ho sakta hai. Aisa ek moment kisi ko abusive nahi bana deta, aur yeh lesson kisi ko diagnose nahi kar sakta. Asli baat pattern hai: kya woh behaviour baar-baar hota hai, kya badhta ja raha hai, batane par kya woh insaan responsibility leta hai, aur kya iska asar yeh hai ki tum pehle se chhota, zyada dara hua ya zyada cut off feel karte ho? Ek kaam ka check hai direction. Healthy relationship mein tumhari duniya dheere-dheere badi hoti hai. Controlling relationship mein sikudti hai: kam dost, kam choices, kam confidence.

body.en: Love bombing is overwhelming attention very early: constant messages, big gifts, 'you are my everything' within days, pressure to commit fast. Warmth early on is not a problem in itself. It becomes a warning pattern when the intensity is used to rush you, and when affection is withdrawn the moment you want space. Possessiveness often follows: checking your phone, deciding your clothes, objecting to your friends, demanding instant replies, turning up uninvited. It is usually explained as care or protection. The test is simple: care respects your no, control punishes it.
body.hg: Love bombing matlab bahut jaldi, bahut zyada attention: non-stop messages, bade gifts, kuch hi dinon mein 'tum hi mera sab kuch ho', jaldi commit karne ka pressure. Shuru mein warmth apne aap mein koi problem nahi hai. Yeh warning pattern tab banta hai jab is intensity ka use tumhe rush karne ke liye ho, aur jaise hi tum thoda space maango, affection wapas kheench liya jaye. Iske baad aksar possessiveness aati hai: phone check karna, kapde decide karna, doston par objection, instant reply ki demand, bina bulaye pahunch jana. Ise aksar care ya protection bola jata hai. Test simple hai: care tumhari 'no' maanti hai, control uski saza deta hai.

body.en: Gaslighting is repeatedly making someone doubt their own memory and judgement: 'That never happened', 'You're too sensitive', even when you clearly remember. Over time you stop trusting yourself and rely on their version. Other manipulation tactics include guilt-tripping, the silent treatment as punishment, threatening to leave or to self-harm unless you obey, and blaming you for their anger. Always take a self-harm threat seriously: tell their family or a trusted adult, call Tele-MANAS 14416, or 112 in danger; you still do not have to obey or stay. Memories also differ honestly, so look for a repeated pattern. Private notes, kept where nobody else can read them, can help.
body.hg: Gaslighting matlab kisi ko baar-baar uski apni memory aur judgement par doubt karana: 'Aisa kabhi hua hi nahi', 'Tum bahut sensitive ho', jabki tumhe clearly yaad hai. Dheere-dheere tum khud par trust karna chhod dete ho aur usi ke version ko sach maanne lagte ho. Manipulation ke aur tareeke hain: guilt-trip karna, punishment ki tarah silent treatment, baat na maanne par chhod dene ya khud ko harm karne ki dhamki, aur apne gusse ka blame tum par daalna. Self-harm ki dhamki ko hamesha seriously lo: uski family ya kisi trusted adult ko batao, Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, ya danger ho toh 112 par; phir bhi tumhe baat maanne ya relationship mein rukne ki zaroorat nahi. Memories honestly bhi alag hoti hain, isliye repeated pattern dekho. Aisi jagah rakhe private notes, jahan koi aur unhe padh na sake, help kar sakte hain.

h.en: When it is abuse, and what to do
h.hg: Jab yeh abuse ho, tab kya karein

body.en: Emotional abuse is ongoing insults, humiliation, threats or control. Physical abuse includes hitting, slapping, pushing, grabbing or throwing things. Sexual coercion is pressuring, guilt-tripping, threatening or wearing someone down into sexual activity or into sending images; with anyone under 18 it is an offence under POCSO whatever was 'agreed'. None of this is caused by the person on the receiving end. Tell someone you trust: a parent, teacher, counsellor or friend. Call 1098 if you are under 18, 181 for women, or 112 in danger. If a friend confides in you, believe them, do not push, and help them reach an adult.
body.hg: Emotional abuse matlab lagataar insults, humiliation, dhamkiyan ya control. Physical abuse mein maarna, thappad, dhakka dena, zor se pakadna ya cheezein phenkna aata hai. Sexual coercion matlab kisi par pressure daal kar, guilt-trip karke, dhamka kar ya thaka kar sexual activity ya images bhejne ke liye manwana; 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath yeh POCSO ke under offence hai, chahe 'haan' boli gayi ho. Inme se kuch bhi jhelne wale ki wajah se nahi hota. Kisi trusted insaan ko batao: parent, teacher, counsellor ya dost. 18 se kam ho toh 1098, women ke liye 181, aur danger mein 112 par call karo. Agar koi dost tumhe bataye, toh us par believe karo, push mat karo, aur kisi adult tak pahunchne mein uski help karo.

claim.en: If it was really that bad, they would just leave.
claim.hg: Agar sach mein itna bura hota, toh woh chhod kar chale jate.

fact.en: Leaving is hard for real reasons: fear, hope that the person will change, shame, family pressure, threats and shrinking confidence. Many people need several attempts and outside support. Asking 'why don't you just leave?' adds blame; asking 'how can I help?' opens a door.
fact.hg: Chhodna real reasons se mushkil hota hai: darr, hope ki woh badal jayega, sharam, family pressure, dhamkiyan aur girta confidence. Kaafi logon ko kai attempts aur bahar ka support lagta hai. 'Chhod kyun nahi dete?' poochna blame badhata hai; 'Main kaise help karoon?' poochna darwaza kholta hai.

takeaways.en: One bad moment is not abuse; a repeated pattern that leaves you smaller, scared or isolated is a serious warning.
takeaways.hg: Ek bura moment abuse nahi hai; baar-baar ka pattern jo tumhe chhota, dara hua ya isolated kar de, serious warning hai.

takeaways.en: Love bombing, possessiveness and gaslighting are ways of gaining control that are often presented as love or care.
takeaways.hg: Love bombing, possessiveness aur gaslighting control paane ke tareeke hain jinhe aksar pyaar ya care bol kar dikhaya jata hai.

takeaways.en: Abuse is never the fault of the person experiencing it, and help is available on 1098, 181 and 112.
takeaways.hg: Abuse mein jhelne wale ki kabhi galti nahi hoti, aur 1098, 181 aur 112 par help milti hai.

activity.en: Think of a couple from a film or series you know. Privately note two behaviours shown as 'romantic' that would be controlling in real life, and what a respectful version would look like.
activity.hg: Kisi film ya series ke ek couple ke baare mein socho. Privately do aise behaviours note karo jinhe 'romantic' dikhaya gaya par real life mein woh controlling hote, aur likho ki unka respectful version kaisa dikhta.

q.en: What best separates a rough patch from an abusive pattern?
q.hg: Rough patch aur abusive pattern mein sabse bada farq kya hai?

options.en: Whether the couple ever argues
options.hg: Couple mein kabhi argument hota hai ya nahi

options.en: Whether the behaviour repeats, escalates and leaves one person afraid or isolated
options.hg: Behaviour baar-baar hota hai, badhta hai aur ek insaan ko dara hua ya isolated chhod deta hai ya nahi

options.en: How long the two have been together
options.hg: Dono kitne time se saath hain

options.en: Whether other people have noticed anything
options.hg: Doosron ne kuch notice kiya hai ya nahi

explain.en: Arguments happen in healthy relationships too. Repetition, escalation and the effect of fear or isolation are what mark a harmful pattern.
explain.hg: Arguments healthy relationships mein bhi hote hain. Baar-baar hona, escalate hona aur darr ya isolation ka asar hi harmful pattern ki pehchaan hai.

q.en: Your friend Riya says her boyfriend checks her phone every day and she is 'not allowed' to meet you any more. What is the most helpful first response?
q.hg: Tumhari dost Riya batati hai ki uska boyfriend roz uska phone check karta hai aur ab use tumse milne ki 'permission nahi' hai. Sabse helpful first response kya hoga?

options.en: Tell her he is abusive and she must break up today
options.hg: Use bolo ki woh abusive hai aur aaj hi breakup karna hoga

options.en: Confront the boyfriend yourself
options.hg: Khud jaa kar boyfriend ko confront karo

options.en: Keep your distance until she sorts it out
options.hg: Jab tak woh khud sort na kar le, distance bana lo

options.en: Listen, say you are worried and there for her, and suggest talking to a trusted adult
options.hg: Uski baat suno, bolo ki tumhe chinta hai aur tum saath ho, aur kisi trusted adult se baat karne ka suggestion do

explain.en: Labelling and ultimatums often make a person defend the partner and pull away. Staying connected, naming your concern and pointing to adult help keeps her safer.
explain.hg: Label lagane aur ultimatum dene se insaan aksar partner ko defend karne lagta hai aur door ho jata hai. Connected rehna, apni concern batana aur adult help ki taraf point karna use zyada safe rakhta hai.

warning.en: If you or someone you know is being hurt or threatened, call 112 in an emergency, Child Helpline 1098 (under 18) or Women Helpline 181. This lesson explains patterns; it cannot judge any one person or relationship.
warning.hg: Agar tumhe ya tumhare kisi jaanne wale ko hurt kiya ja raha hai ya dhamkaya ja raha hai, toh emergency mein 112, Child Helpline 1098 (18 se kam) ya Women Helpline 181 par call karo. Yeh lesson patterns samjhata hai; kisi ek insaan ya relationship ko judge nahi kar sakta.

title.en: Adult Relationships: Closeness, Conflict and Commitment
title.hg: Adult Relationships: Closeness, Conflict aur Commitment

subtitle.en: Emotional intimacy, fair fights, distance and consent in marriage
subtitle.hg: Emotional intimacy, fair fights, long-distance aur shaadi mein consent

hook.en: Chemistry gets a relationship started. What keeps it healthy is duller and far more useful: honest talk, fair fights and consent that never expires.
hook.hg: Chemistry relationship start karwati hai. Use healthy rakhti hain thodi boring par kahin zyada kaam ki cheezein: honest baat, fair fights aur aisa consent jo kabhi expire nahi hota.

objectives.en: Explain what emotional intimacy is and how it is built.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki emotional intimacy kya hai aur kaise banti hai.

objectives.en: Use basic conflict-resolution tools without contempt, threats or stonewalling.
objectives.hg: Contempt, dhamki ya stonewalling ke bina conflict resolve karne ke basic tools use kar sako.

objectives.en: Understand that consent stays necessary inside marriage and know where to seek help.
objectives.hg: Samajh sako ki shaadi ke andar bhi consent zaroori rehta hai aur jaan sako ki help kahan milegi.

body.en: Emotional intimacy is feeling safe enough to be known: sharing fears, failures, money worries and hopes without being mocked or having them used against you later. It is built slowly, through small disclosures that are met with care. It also needs clear expectations. Before a serious commitment or marriage, talk plainly about money, careers, where you will live, the role of families, children or no children, household work, faith and sexual health. In arranged and love matches alike, unspoken assumptions such as 'obviously you'll quit your job' become later fights. Differing is fine; discovering the difference after the wedding is costly.
body.hg: Emotional intimacy matlab itna safe feel karna ki saamne wala tumhe sach mein jaan sake: apne darr, failures, paison ki tension aur hopes share kar paana, bina is darr ke ki mazaak udega ya baad mein yahi baatein tumhare against use hongi. Yeh dheere-dheere banti hai, chhoti-chhoti baatein share karne se jinhe care ke saath suna jaye. Iske liye clear expectations bhi zaroori hain. Kisi serious commitment ya shaadi se pehle khul kar baat karo: paisa, career, kahan rahenge, families ka role, bachche chahiye ya nahi, ghar ka kaam, faith aur sexual health. Arranged ho ya love marriage, 'obviously tum job chhod dogi' jaisi unspoken assumptions aage chal kar jhagde banti hain. Alag sochna theek hai; yeh farq shaadi ke baad pata chalna mehenga padta hai.

body.en: Conflict is normal between two people with different histories. What predicts trouble is how you fight. Helpful habits: raise one issue at a time, describe the behaviour instead of attacking character ('I felt ignored when plans changed', not 'you're selfish'), listen and repeat back what you heard, and take a break when voices rise, with a promise to return. Avoid contempt, name-calling, dragging in old mistakes, threats to leave used as a weapon and long punishing silences. Aim for a solution both can live with, not a winner. Fear of your partner's reaction, though, is not a communication problem; it is a safety problem.
body.hg: Alag-alag background wale do logon mein conflict hona normal hai. Trouble ka andaza isse lagta hai ki tum ladte kaise ho. Kaam ki aadatein: ek baar mein ek hi issue uthao, insaan ke character par attack karne ke bajaye behaviour batao ('Plan badalne par mujhe ignored feel hua', na ki 'tum selfish ho'), suno aur jo suna use repeat karo, aur awaazein oonchi hone lagein toh break lo, is promise ke saath ki baat par wapas aaoge. Contempt, name-calling, purani galtiyan ghaseetna, chhodne ki dhamki ko weapon banana aur punishment wali lambi silence se bacho. Goal aisa solution ho jiske saath dono reh sakein, jeet-haar nahi. Lekin partner ke reaction se darr lagna communication problem nahi hai; woh safety problem hai.

body.en: Jobs, studies and migration keep many Indian couples in different cities or countries. Distance works better when both agree on the basics: how often you will talk, what 'exclusive' means, how visits and costs are shared, and whether there is a plan to live in the same place eventually. Regular calls help, but constant tracking does not build trust. Demanding live location, instant replies or video proof of where someone is counts as surveillance. Keep your own friends and routine. If intimate images are ever shared, that needs free consent each time, and passing them on without consent is a crime.
body.hg: Job, padhai aur migration ki wajah se bahut se Indian couples alag cities ya countries mein rehte hain. Distance tab better chalti hai jab dono basics par agree hon: kitni baar baat hogi, 'exclusive' ka matlab kya hai, visits ka time aur kharcha kaise share hoga, aur kya aage chal kar ek jagah rehne ka koi plan hai. Regular calls help karte hain, par constant tracking se trust nahi banta. Live location, instant reply ya 'kahan ho' ka video proof maangna surveillance hai. Apne dost aur apna routine banaye rakho. Agar kabhi intimate images share hon, toh har baar bina pressure ka consent zaroori hai, aur bina consent unhe aage bhejna crime hai.

body.en: A wedding does not create a permanent yes. Each partner keeps the right to refuse sexual activity on any day, for any reason, and pressure, threats or force inside a marriage cause real harm. Indian criminal law currently keeps an exception under which intercourse by a man with his adult wife is not classed as rape; this is contested and before the courts. Other remedies exist: the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 covers physical, sexual, verbal, emotional and economic abuse and allows protection orders. Women Helpline 181 and 112 can guide you. Laws change, and this is not legal advice.
body.hg: Shaadi se permanent 'yes' nahi ban jati. Har partner ko kisi bhi din, kisi bhi reason se sexual activity ko mana karne ka haq rehta hai, aur shaadi ke andar pressure, dhamki ya zabardasti se real harm hota hai. Indian criminal law mein filhaal ek exception bana hua hai, jiske under pati ka apni adult patni ke saath intercourse 'rape' ki category mein nahi aata; is par vivaad hai aur maamla courts mein hai. Doosre legal raaste maujood hain: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 physical, sexual, verbal, emotional aur economic abuse ko cover karta hai aur protection orders ki suvidha deta hai. Women Helpline 181 aur 112 guide kar sakti hain. Laws badalte rehte hain, aur yeh legal advice nahi hai.

claim.en: Couples who truly love each other never need to talk about boundaries; they just know.
claim.hg: Jo couples sach mein pyaar karte hain, unhe boundaries par baat karne ki zaroorat nahi padti; unhe bas pata hota hai.

fact.en: Nobody can read minds. Saying needs and limits out loud prevents misunderstandings; it does not kill romance. Guessing breeds resentment, while asking gives you real information.
fact.hg: Koi kisi ka mind nahi padh sakta. Apni needs aur limits bol kar batane se misunderstandings rukti hain; isse romance khatam nahi hota. Guess karne se resentment palta hai, jabki poochne se real information milti hai.

takeaways.en: Emotional intimacy grows when honesty is met with care, not mockery.
takeaways.hg: Emotional intimacy tab badhti hai jab honesty ka jawab care se mile, mazaak se nahi.

takeaways.en: Fair conflict targets the problem, not the person, and never relies on fear.
takeaways.hg: Fair conflict problem par hota hai, insaan par nahi, aur kabhi darr par nahi tikta.

takeaways.en: Marriage does not replace consent, and legal and helpline support exists when a partner uses force or pressure.
takeaways.hg: Shaadi consent ko replace nahi karti, aur partner force ya pressure use kare toh legal aur helpline support maujood hai.

activity.en: Write down five topics you would want to discuss before a long-term commitment, for example money, careers and family roles. Note your own honest position on each before imagining a partner's.
activity.hg: Paanch topics likho jin par tum kisi long-term commitment se pehle baat karna chahoge, jaise paisa, career aur family roles. Partner ki opinion imagine karne se pehle har topic par apni honest position note karo.

q.en: Which sentence follows the fair-fighting approach?
q.hg: Kaunsa sentence fair-fighting approach follow karta hai?

options.en: You always ruin everything.
options.hg: Tum hamesha sab kuch bigaad dete ho.

options.en: Fine, do whatever you want. I'm done talking.
options.hg: Theek hai, jo mann kare karo. Mujhe ab baat nahi karni.

options.en: I felt hurt when the plan changed without telling me. Can we talk about it?
options.hg: Bina bataye plan badla toh mujhe hurt hua. Kya hum is par baat kar sakte hain?

options.en: My family was right about you.
options.hg: Mere gharwale tumhare baare mein sahi kehte the.

explain.en: It names one specific behaviour and your feeling, and invites a conversation. The others attack character, shut the talk down or bring in outsiders as weapons.
explain.hg: Yeh ek specific behaviour aur apni feeling batata hai aur conversation invite karta hai. Baaki sentences character par attack karte hain, baat band kar dete hain ya bahar walon ko weapon banate hain.

q.en: After marriage, a spouse no longer has the right to refuse sexual activity.
q.hg: Shaadi ke baad spouse ko sexual activity se mana karne ka haq nahi rehta.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Marriage is not consent. Every person keeps the right to say no at any time, and force or pressure within marriage is harmful whatever the current criminal-law exception says.
explain.hg: Shaadi consent nahi hai. Har insaan ko kisi bhi time no bolne ka haq rehta hai, aur shaadi ke andar force ya pressure harmful hai, chahe criminal law ka current exception kuch bhi bole.

warning.en: If a partner or spouse uses force, threats or pressure, you can call Women Helpline 181 or Emergency 112. This lesson is general education, not legal advice, and laws can change.
warning.hg: Agar partner ya spouse force, dhamki ya pressure use kare, toh Women Helpline 181 ya Emergency 112 par call kar sakte ho. Yeh lesson general education hai, legal advice nahi, aur laws badal sakte hain.

subtitle.en: How to hear no, end things decently and get back up
subtitle.hg: 'No' kaise sunein, cheezein decently kaise end karein aur wapas kaise uthein

hook.en: A no hurts. A breakup hurts more. Neither one is a verdict on what you are worth.
hook.hg: 'No' sunna chubhta hai. Breakup usse zyada chubhta hai. Par dono mein se koi bhi tumhari worth ka verdict nahi hai.

objectives.en: Respond to rejection respectfully, whether you are giving it or receiving it.
objectives.hg: Rejection ko respect ke saath handle kar sako, chahe tum mana kar rahe ho ya tumhe mana kiya gaya ho.

objectives.en: Describe healthy ways to cope with a breakup.
objectives.hg: Breakup se cope karne ke healthy tareeke bata sako.

objectives.en: Recognise when low mood needs support and where to find it.
objectives.hg: Pehchaan sako ki low mood ko kab support chahiye aur woh kahan milega.

body.en: When someone says they are not interested, the respectful reply is short: 'Okay, thanks for being honest.' Then give them space. Asking again and again, following them, messaging from new accounts or getting friends to plead is harassment. It can be a crime too: stalking when a man does it to a woman, and POCSO sexual harassment when the target is under 18. Films show persistence as romance; in real life it frightens people. If you are saying no, be clear and kind: 'I don't feel the same way.' You owe no reason, second chance or friendship. If the person will not stop, tell a trusted adult.
body.hg: Jab koi bole ki use interest nahi hai, toh respectful reply chhota hota hai: 'Okay, honest hone ke liye thanks.' Phir use space do. Baar-baar poochna, peecha karna, naye accounts se message karna ya doston se sifarish karwana harassment hai. Yeh crime bhi ho sakta hai: jab koi aadmi kisi woman ke saath aisa kare toh stalking, aur jab saamne wala 18 se kam umar ka ho toh POCSO ke under sexual harassment. Filmein peeche pade rehne ko romance dikhati hain; real life mein isse log darr jate hain. Agar 'no' tum bol rahe ho, toh clear aur kind raho: 'Mere mann mein waisi feeling nahi hai.' Reason dena, second chance dena ya dosti rakhna tumhari zimmedari nahi. Agar woh insaan na ruke, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao.

h.hg: Breakup itna hurt kyun karta hai

body.en: A breakup is a real loss. You lose a person, a routine and plans you had imagined, and the mind reacts much as it does to other grief: poor sleep, low appetite, replaying conversations, sudden tears. This is not weakness or drama. It usually eases over weeks, in waves, not in a straight line. What helps: telling one or two people you trust, keeping meals, sleep and study going, moving your body, and taking a break from their social media. What makes it worse: checking their profile late at night, using alcohol or other substances to numb it, or rushing into something new.
body.hg: Breakup ek real loss hai. Tum ek insaan, ek routine aur imagine kiye hue plans khote ho, aur mind waise hi react karta hai jaise kisi aur grief mein: neend kharab, bhookh kam, conversations ka baar-baar dimaag mein replay, achanak rona aa jana. Yeh weakness ya drama nahi hai. Yeh usually kuch hafton mein halka hota hai, waves ki tarah, straight line mein nahi. Kya help karta hai: ek-do trusted logon ko batana, khana, neend aur padhai chalu rakhna, body ko move karna, aur unke social media se kuch time ka break. Kya haalat bigadta hai: late night unki profile check karna, dard dabane ke liye alcohol ya doosre nashe ka sahara lena, ya jaldbaazi mein kisi naye relationship mein kood jana.

body.en: If you are ending it, do it directly and privately, not through a friend, a status update or silence. State the decision clearly without listing their faults. Afterwards, respect their privacy: do not share their chats, photos or secrets, and do not run them down in class or online. Threatening to leak private pictures or messages is a crime, not revenge. If someone threatens you this way, do not negotiate or pay; keep the chat, do not forward the images, and report with a trusted adult to 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, or call 1098 if you are under 18.
body.hg: Agar relationship tum end kar rahe ho, toh seedha aur privately bolo, kisi dost, status update ya silence ke through nahi. Decision clearly batao, unki kamiyan ginaye bina. Uske baad unki privacy respect karo: unki chats, photos ya secrets kisi se share mat karo, aur class mein ya online unki burai mat karo. Private pictures ya messages leak karne ki dhamki dena crime hai, revenge nahi. Agar koi tumhe aisi dhamki de, toh negotiate mat karo aur paise mat do; chat sambhal kar rakho, images forward mat karo, aur kisi trusted adult ke saath 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in par report karo, ya 18 se kam ho toh 1098 par call karo.

h.en: Your worth is not a relationship status
h.hg: Tumhari worth relationship status nahi hai

body.en: Self-worth is the steady sense that you matter whether or not someone chooses you. Being single, rejected or dumped says something about the fit between two people, not about your value. Build it from things you control: skills you practise, promises you keep to yourself, friends who are honest with you, and how you treat people. Watch out for the thought 'I am nothing without them'. If sadness lasts more than two weeks, stops you eating, sleeping or studying, or brings thoughts of harming yourself, talk to an adult you trust or call Tele-MANAS on 14416. Asking for help is a strength.
body.hg: Self-worth woh steady feeling hai ki tum matter karte ho, chahe koi tumhe choose kare ya nahi. Single hona, reject hona ya dump hona do logon ke fit ke baare mein kuch batata hai, tumhari value ke baare mein nahi. Ise un cheezon se banao jo tumhare control mein hain: jo skills tum practise karte ho, khud se kiye promises jo tum nibhate ho, woh dost jo tumse sach bolte hain, aur tum logon se kaise pesh aate ho. 'Uske bina main kuch nahi' wali soch se saavdhan raho. Agar sadness do hafte se zyada rahe, khana, neend ya padhai rok de, ya khud ko harm karne ke khayal aayein, toh kisi trusted adult se baat karo ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Help maangna strength hai.

claim.en: Getting over someone quickly means you never really cared.
claim.hg: Kisi se jaldi move on kar lena matlab tumhe kabhi sach mein care thi hi nahi.

fact.en: People heal at different speeds. Some feel better in weeks, others take months, and both are normal. How long you hurt is not a measure of how real the feelings were.
fact.hg: Har insaan alag speed se heal hota hai. Kuch log hafton mein better feel karte hain, kuch ko mahine lagte hain, aur dono normal hain. Dard kitne din raha, isse yeh nahi naapa ja sakta ki feelings kitni real thi.

takeaways.en: A no deserves a calm okay, and continuing to chase after a clear no is harassment.
takeaways.hg: 'No' ka jawab calm 'okay' hona chahiye, aur clear 'no' ke baad bhi peeche pade rehna harassment hai.

takeaways.en: Breakup pain is real grief that eases with time, routine and support.
takeaways.hg: Breakup ka dard real grief hai jo time, routine aur support se halka hota hai.

takeaways.en: Your worth does not depend on being chosen, and low mood that lasts deserves help.
takeaways.hg: Tumhari worth is par depend nahi karti ki kisi ne tumhe choose kiya ya nahi, aur lambi chalne wali low mood ke liye help leni chahiye.

activity.en: Write a short note to yourself listing five things that are true about you and have nothing to do with any relationship: skills, values, things you have done for others. Keep it somewhere private for hard days.
activity.hg: Apne naam ek chhota note likho jisme paanch aisi baatein hon jo tumhare baare mein sach hain aur jinka kisi relationship se lena-dena nahi: skills, values, doosron ke liye kiye gaye kaam. Mushkil dinon ke liye ise kisi private jagah sambhal kar rakho.

q.en: Arjun tells Nisha he likes her. She says, 'I'm sorry, I don't feel that way.' What should Arjun do?
q.hg: Arjun Nisha ko batata hai ki woh use pasand karta hai. Nisha bolti hai, 'Sorry, mere mann mein aisa kuch nahi hai.' Arjun ko kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Ask her friends to convince her
options.hg: Uske friends se bole ki use convince karein

options.en: Keep messaging so she sees he is serious
options.hg: Message karta rahe taaki use lage ki woh serious hai

options.en: Tell classmates that she led him on
options.hg: Class mein bol de ki Nisha ne hi use hope di thi

options.en: Say okay, thank her for being honest and give her space
options.hg: 'Okay' bole, honest hone ke liye thanks bole aur use space de

explain.en: Her answer is complete. Accepting it calmly respects her and protects his own dignity; pushing, recruiting friends or spreading stories is harassment.
explain.hg: Nisha ka jawab complete hai. Use calmly accept karna Nisha ki respect hai aur Arjun ki apni dignity bhi bachata hai; push karna, doston ko lagana ya stories failana harassment hai.

q.en: Which of these suggests that sadness after a breakup needs extra support?
q.hg: Inme se kya batata hai ki breakup ke baad ki sadness ko extra support chahiye?

options.en: Crying when a song reminds you of them
options.hg: Koi gaana sun kar unki yaad mein rona aa jana

options.en: Missing them on weekends
options.hg: Weekend par unki kami feel hona

options.en: Low mood for more than two weeks that stops you eating, sleeping or studying
options.hg: Do hafte se zyada ki low mood jo khana, neend ya padhai rok de

options.en: Not wanting to look at their photos
options.hg: Unki photos dekhne ka mann na hona

explain.en: Tears, missing someone and avoiding reminders are ordinary grief. When low mood lasts and disrupts daily life, talking to a trusted adult or Tele-MANAS 14416 is the right step.
explain.hg: Rona, kisi ko miss karna aur reminders avoid karna normal grief hai. Jab low mood lambi chale aur daily life disturb karne lage, tab kisi trusted adult ya Tele-MANAS 14416 se baat karna sahi step hai.

warning.en: If you have thoughts of harming yourself, or someone threatens to leak your private images, tell a trusted adult now. Tele-MANAS 14416, Child Helpline 1098, Cybercrime helpline 1930, Emergency 112.
warning.hg: Agar khud ko harm karne ke khayal aayein, ya koi tumhari private images leak karne ki dhamki de, toh abhi kisi trusted adult ko batao. Tele-MANAS 14416, Child Helpline 1098, Cybercrime helpline 1930, Emergency 112.

subtitle.en: Meeting safely, consent every time, and telling the truth about what you want
subtitle.hg: Safely milna, har baar consent, aur jo chahte ho uske baare mein sach bolna

hook.en: A match is not a background check, and a date is not a promise of sex. Whether you want something casual or something serious, safety and honesty are not optional extras.
hook.hg: Match ho jaana koi background check nahi hai, aur date sex ka promise nahi hai. Tum kuch casual chahte ho ya serious, safety aur honesty optional extras nahi hain.

objectives.en: Plan a first meeting with someone from an app in a way that keeps you safe.
objectives.hg: App pe mile kisi insaan se first meeting aise plan kar sako ki tum safe raho.

objectives.en: Spot catfishing and romance scams before they cost you money or safety.
objectives.hg: Catfishing aur romance scams ko paise ya safety khone se pehle pehchaan sako.

objectives.en: Explain the consent, STI and pregnancy realities of casual sex, and why honesty matters in casual, committed and live-in relationships.
objectives.hg: Casual sex mein consent, STI aur pregnancy ki realities samjha sako, aur yeh bhi ki casual, committed aur live-in relationships mein honesty kyun zaroori hai.

body.en: Dating apps are for adults, and people of every gender use them for friendship, casual sex, relationships or marriage. Before meeting, have a video call to confirm the person matches their photos. Meet in a busy public place, arrange your own transport both ways, and tell a friend who you are meeting and where, and share your live location. Keep your phone charged and carry your own money. Get your own drink, keep it in sight, and never leave it unattended. Do not share your home address early. If something feels off, leave; you owe nobody an explanation. These steps matter for men and queer people as much as women.
body.hg: Dating apps adults ke liye hain, aur har gender ke log inhe dosti, casual sex, relationship ya shaadi ke liye use karte hain. Milne se pehle video call karo taaki confirm ho ki insaan apni photos jaisa hi hai. Kisi busy public place pe milo, aane-jaane ka transport khud arrange karo, aur kisi friend ko batao ki tum kisse aur kahan mil rahe ho, aur apni live location share karo. Phone charged rakho aur apne paise saath rakho. Apni drink khud lo, use nazar ke saamne rakho aur kabhi unattended mat chhodo. Shuru mein ghar ka address mat batao. Kuch off lage toh nikal jao; tumhe kisi ko explanation dene ki zaroorat nahi hai. Yeh steps men aur queer logon ke liye bhi utne hi zaroori hain jitne women ke liye.

body.en: Catfishing means using a fake identity: stolen photos, a false name, job or marital status. Romance scammers go further. They build affection fast, avoid video calls and meetings, then need money: a medical emergency, a parcel stuck at customs, a 'sure' investment. Sometimes a match insists on one particular bar or café, where a hugely inflated bill arrives. Some record intimate video calls and blackmail; queer users are often threatened with being outed. Never send money, OTPs or intimate images to someone you have not met and verified. Being fooled is not stupidity; these are practised criminals. Report fast at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in; quick reporting can sometimes freeze a payment.
body.hg: Catfishing ka matlab hai fake identity use karna: chori ki hui photos, jhootha naam, job ya marital status. Romance scammers isse aage jaate hain. Woh fast affection build karte hain, video call aur milne se bachte hain, phir unhe paise chahiye hote hain: koi medical emergency, customs mein atka parcel ya koi 'pakka' investment. Ek aur pattern mein match kisi ek particular bar ya cafe pe hi milne ki zid karta hai, jahan bahut inflated bill aa jaata hai. Kuch log intimate video calls record karke blackmail karte hain; queer users ko aksar out karne ki dhamki di jaati hai. Jisse tum mile nahi aur jise verify nahi kiya, use kabhi paise, OTP ya intimate images mat bhejo. Dhokha kha jaana bewakoofi nahi hai; yeh practised criminals hain. 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe jaldi report karo, kyunki fast reporting se kabhi-kabhi payment freeze ho sakti hai.

h.en: Consent every time, and what casual sex carries
h.hg: Har baar consent, aur casual sex ke saath kya aata hai

body.en: Matching, flirting, sexting, going home with someone or earlier sex is not consent to sex now. Consent is a clear, willing yes to each act, and can be withdrawn at any point. A person who is very drunk, drugged, asleep or frightened cannot consent, and removing a condom without agreement is a violation. Many STIs cause no symptoms, so a healthy-looking partner tells you nothing. Condoms greatly reduce risk but do not remove it; oral sex can pass on infections too. Pregnancy can follow a single encounter. Know the time limits: emergency contraception within five days, HIV PEP started within 72 hours. Regular testing is routine care, not a confession.
body.hg: Match hona, flirt karna, sexting, kisi ke saath ghar jaana ya pehle sex kar chuke hona, abhi ke sex ka consent nahi hai. Consent har act ke liye ek clear, willing 'haan' hai, aur ise kisi bhi point pe wapas liya ja sakta hai. Jo insaan bahut drunk ho, drugged ho, soya ho ya dara hua ho, woh consent nahi de sakta; aur bina agreement ke condom hatana ek violation hai. Kai STIs ke koi symptoms nahi hote, isliye partner ka healthy dikhna kuch nahi batata. Condoms risk bahut kam karte hain par khatam nahi karte, aur oral sex se bhi infections pass ho sakte hain. Ek hi baar ke encounter se bhi pregnancy ho sakti hai. Time limits jaan lo: emergency contraception paanch din ke andar, aur HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar start. Regular testing routine care hai, koi confession nahi.

h.en: Honesty, cheating, ghosting and living in

body.en: Say what you want: casual, exclusive, marriage or unsure. Wanting only casual sex is not shameful; pretending to want commitment to get sex is deceit, and Indian law can treat it as an offence when someone has sex with a woman after a marriage promise they never meant to keep. Hiding a spouse or other partners takes away the other person's choice. Infidelity is a health issue too: an unknowing partner can catch STIs, so test and tell. Ghosting leaves people doubting themselves; a short honest message is kinder. Unmarried adults may live together in India; families often judge it, and Uttarakhand requires live-in registration, so check locally.
body.hg: Jo chahte ho woh clearly bolo: casual, exclusive, shaadi, ya abhi sure nahi. Sirf casual sex chahna sharam ki baat nahi hai; par sex paane ke liye commitment chahne ka natak karna dhokha hai, aur jab koi shaadi ka aisa promise karke, jise nibhane ka uska kabhi irada nahi tha, kisi woman ke saath sex kare, toh Indian law ise offence maan sakta hai. Spouse ya doosre partners ki baat chhupana saamne wale se decide karne ka haq chheen leta hai. Infidelity health ka issue bhi hai: anjaan partner ko STI ho sakta hai, isliye test karao aur batao. Ghosting logon ko khud par doubt karne par majboor kar deti hai; ek chhota honest message zyada kind hai. Unmarried adults India mein saath reh sakte hain; families aksar ise judge karti hain, aur Uttarakhand mein live-in registration zaroori hai, isliye apne state ke rules check kar lo.

claim.en: Only women need to think about safety on dating apps.
claim.hg: Dating apps pe safety ke baare mein sirf women ko sochna padta hai.

fact.en: Women face a great deal of harassment and assault, but men are commonly targeted by money scams, inflated-bill set-ups, robbery and blackmail, and queer and transgender users by threats of outing. The safety steps are for everyone.
fact.hg: Women ko bahut zyada harassment aur assault face karna padta hai, par men bhi aksar money scams, inflated bill wale set-ups, loot aur blackmail ka target bante hain, aur queer aur transgender users ko out karne ki dhamkiyan milti hain. Safety steps sabke liye hain.

takeaways.en: Verify the person, meet in public, tell a friend, and stay in control of your own transport and drink.
takeaways.hg: Insaan ko verify karo, public mein milo, friend ko batao, aur apne transport aur apni drink ka control apne paas rakho.

takeaways.en: Consent is needed every time; STI and pregnancy risks are real in casual and committed sex alike, and new or multiple partners raise STI risk, so use condoms and test regularly.
takeaways.hg: Consent har baar zaroori hai; STI aur pregnancy ka risk casual aur committed dono mein real hai, aur naye ya multiple partners se STI risk badhta hai, isliye condoms use karo aur regularly test karao.

takeaways.en: Honesty about what you want, who else is involved and your sexual health is what makes any arrangement fair.
takeaways.hg: Tum kya chahte ho, aur kaun involved hai, aur tumhari sexual health kaisi hai, in sabke baare mein honesty hi kisi bhi arrangement ko fair banati hai.

activity.en: Write your own first-meeting safety plan: where you would meet, which friend you would tell, how you would get home, and one sentence you could use to leave early. Keep it where you can find it.
activity.hg: First meeting ke liye apna safety plan likho: kahan miloge, kis friend ko bataoge, ghar kaise jaoge, aur ek sentence jo jaldi nikalne ke liye bol sakte ho. Ise aisi jagah rakho jahan easily mil jaaye.

q.en: Kabir, 27, has chatted for three weeks with a match who always cancels video calls. She now says her mother is in hospital and asks for ₹20,000 by UPI. What is the safest response?
q.hg: 27 saal ka Kabir teen hafte se ek match se chat kar raha hai, jo har baar video call cancel kar deti hai. Ab woh kehti hai ki uski maa hospital mein hai aur UPI se ₹20,000 maangti hai. Sabse safe response kya hai?

options.en: Send half the amount to show he cares but is being careful
options.hg: Aadha amount bhej de, taaki dikhe ki use care hai par woh careful bhi hai

options.en: Send nothing, stop replying, keep the chats and report at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
options.hg: Kuch na bheje, reply karna band kare, chats rakhe aur 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report kare

options.en: Send it only after she promises in writing to return it
options.hg: Tabhi bheje jab woh likhkar promise kare ki wapas kar degi

options.en: Send it, because refusing would be cruel if the story is true
options.hg: Bhej de, kyunki agar baat sach hui toh mana karna cruel hoga

explain.en: Avoiding video calls and then asking for urgent money is the classic romance-scam pattern. Paying any amount usually brings more demands; keeping the evidence and reporting is the safe step.
explain.hg: Video call se bachna aur phir urgent paise maangna romance scam ka classic pattern hai. Thoda bhi amount dene par usually aur demands aati hain; evidence rakhna aur report karna hi safe step hai.

q.en: A person who looks healthy and has no symptoms can still pass on an STI.
q.hg: Jo insaan healthy dikhta hai aur jisme koi symptoms nahi hain, usse bhi STI pass ho sakta hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Many STIs cause no symptoms for months or years, so only testing can tell. That is why condoms and regular testing matter with new or multiple partners.
explain.hg: Kai STIs mahino ya saalon tak koi symptoms nahi dikhate, isliye sirf testing se hi pata chalta hai. Isiliye naye ya multiple partners ke saath condoms aur regular testing zaroori hain.

warning.en: If you were assaulted, or think your drink was spiked, go to a hospital or call 112: HIV PEP must start within 72 hours and emergency contraception works for up to 5 days. It is not your fault, whatever you agreed to earlier. Women Helpline 181, Cybercrime 1930, Tele-MANAS 14416, free legal aid 15100. Legal points here are general information, not legal advice, and laws change.
warning.hg: Agar tum par assault hua hai, ya lagta hai ki tumhari drink spike ki gayi thi, toh hospital jao ya 112 pe call karo: HIV PEP 72 ghante ke andar start honi chahiye aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai. Tumne pehle jo bhi haan boli ho, yeh tumhari galti nahi hai. Women Helpline 181, Cybercrime 1930, Tele-MANAS 14416, free legal aid 15100. Yahan ki legal baatein general information hain, legal advice nahi, aur laws badalte rehte hain.
